summary: To obtain a position that offers many opportunities for growth and development that will enhance my existing knowledge in Management and Leadership. In return, I will give my very best to the company so it can achieve its goals and aspirations to continue future success.
skills: Ability to work as part of a team
Strong analytical and problem solving skills

experience.title: HR Manager
responsibilities: Supervised, coached, and counseled staff.
Guided employees through employment processes, including corrective action and documentation.
Resolved complex policy issues and conducted investigations.
Provided guidance for employee development, transfer, and promotion.
Managed annual talent review, performance goal setting, performance review, development planning, and compensation planning.
Designed and facilitated new employee assimilation, orientation, coaching sessions, team building, and interventions.
Mentored less experienced staff.
Participated in special projects and other duties as assigned.

experience.title: Office Operations Manager
responsibilities: Provided first point of contact and daily administrative support to leadership and executive staff.
Implemented quality improvement ideas and conducted monthly audits of security policies.
Communicated team performance and attendance directly to the Vice President.
Planned, managed, and communicated special projects and events such as employee recognition programs and community activities.
Prepared customer correspondence.
Served as liaison between support staff and other divisions.
Assisted with day‑to‑day HR operations including employee orientation, development, and record‑keeping.

experience.title: Customer Support Manager
responsibilities: Managed an email support team of ten members.
Trained new employees on systems and customer handling skills.
Led multiple projects, planning, executing, and ensuring timely completion.
Handled escalated customer issues.

experience.title: Teller
responsibilities: Processed customer transactions and managed finances.
Recorded transactions accurately and in compliance with bank procedures.
Ensured compliance with internal controls and policies.
Advised customers on bank products and services.

experience.title: Retail Support
responsibilities: Supervised and trained new hires and junior staff on work procedures, systems, and processes.
Acted as a mentor and peer coach.
Provided retail customer service and sales via telephone and email.

experience.title: Administration / Customer Services / Mentor
responsibilities: Kept records of customer interactions and transactions.
Prepared correspondence and maintained files.
Assisted the public by answering inquiries, investigating situations, and resolving problems.

experience.title: Flight Attendant/Purser
responsibilities: Acted as Purser, preparing reports on passenger details and inventory.
Maintained records of customer interactions and complaints.
Served as liaison between pilot and passengers.
Supervised junior flight attendants and managed staff briefings.
